title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree. Provide a Python 3 implementation.
answer: Walk left when both values are smaller, right when both are larger; otherwise the current node is the split point. Time: O(h); space: O(1).

question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree. Provide a Python 3 implementation.

title: Find Median from Data Stream
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Find Median from Data Stream. Provide a Python 3 implementation.
answer: Keep a max-heap for the lower half and min-heap for the upper half, balanced so lower has at most one extra item. Time: O(log n) per insertion; O(1) median; space: O(n).

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Longest Increasing Subsequence. Provide a Python 3 implementation.
